announced on Friday that it received a NYSE American compliance notice for failing to meet the exchange’s $4M minimum stockholders’ equity requirement.
has no immediate impact on trading. The stock will continue trading on NYSE American, but with a “.BC” below-compliance designation.
The company must submit a compliance plan by Oct. 21, 2026, with until March 21, 2028, to regain compliance.
If the plan is rejected, not submitted, or the company fails to make sufficient progress, NYSE American could begin delisting proceedings.
However, the stock traded nearly 4% higher at ~$1.17 in the after-hours trading session.

title: Calidi Biotherapeutics gets NYSE compliance warning but stock surprises
